card.capacity_status_quote:
On lead times and supply chain, in general we are managing through issues.
None are impacting our production or commitments to customers. This is one of the benefits of moving to the extended factories.
card.demand_direction_quote: the momentum in our business continues to build in support of strong demand for AI compute. This surge in demand across both front end and advanced packaging resulted in first quarter revenue above our original guidance range
card.guidance_direction_quote: We previously announced on April 16 our Q2 revenue expectation of $320 million to $330 million, representing, at the midpoint, a 10% increase to previous analyst expectations and 28% year-over-year growth.
card.constraint_owner_quote: Lead times are extending out a little bit, but so far no big issues, and we are able to meet customer demand.
